name: ExtendIntermediateSigmas
plain: Inserts extra sigmas between neighbours in a chosen sigma range, adding steps only where you want them. Spacing inside each gap is linear or one of two eased forms. The default end_at_sigma of 12 only subdivides the very top of an SD-style range.
math:
x = linspace(0,1,steps+1)[1:−1]; f linear: x; 'cosine': sin(xπ/2); 'sine': 1−cos(xπ/2).
For each gap with end_at ≤ σ_i ≤ start_at (start_at<0 means ∞): insert σ_i + f(x)·(σ_{i+1}−σ_i).
label: from code
surprise: The spacing named 'cosine' is the sine curve and 'sine' is 1−cosine (nodes_custom_sampler.py:321-322).
